title: Derivation of Closed-Loop Transfer Functions for PD Control Systems
expert_review: A concise yet effective problem for practicing block diagram reduction and transfer function derivation for a common controller type. Tests algebraic manipulation skills within a control systems context.
source: Provided User Data, typical of control systems exercises
learning_objectives: Apply block diagram algebra to derive closed-loop transfer functions.
Manipulate rational expressions in the Laplace variable 's' to simplify transfer functions.
Recognize the different structural implementations of Proportional-Derivative (PD) control.
Express a control system's transfer function in standard polynomial ratio form.
